descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-18 Billing Suggestion · S24 Billing card on phone width and WebKit: code, level and long quotes readable, nothing cut off

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U6 A code is always shown, with the elements (Problem, Data, Risk) and the quotes from the note underneath, presented as a suggestion for the physician to verify. … (UAT TC-18; TFA-92596 AC 6) — gate: blocked: TFA-92596 ready for pr
  • U14 Run in both Hospital and Nursing Home and pass in both; Nursing Home has a working billing block with the SNF families. (UAT 3.3; UAT TC-21 step 6; TFA-92599 AC 10) — gate: blocked: TFA-92596 ready for pr; TFA-92599 in progress

Test design technique: Device (device) — Look at the layout and gestures at phone size or on a real device (iPhone / Pixel).

Given Visual lane targets Pixel 7 (Chromium) and iPhone 15 (WebKit)

When Open Post-Round with a seeded billing suggestion whose quotes are long, in both contexts

Then The code and level are visible without horizontal scroll, quotes wrap, the retry / time buttons are at least 44 px tall

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): visual-checks.ts: no horizontal overflow, tap-target size, screenshot kept as evidence

Where it ran: local newspec-c (new Playwright specs); test method VISUAL · Visual (screenshots for a person); lane planned in the matrix: visual / mobile (blocked)

S24 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-18.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: local — main e02167f → 25acd727 (10-15/16 re-tests), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane newspec-c.

Test method: VISUAL · Visual (screenshots for a person) — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: newspec-c.

UAT item: TC-18 Billing Suggestion · Section: A4 · Post-Round · Scenario: TC-18/S24

Billing card on phone width and WebKit: code, level and long quotes readable, nothing cut off

Tickets: TFA-92596 Billing Suggestion (ready for qa); TFA-92599 Hospital vs. Nursing-Home Context Switch (ready for qa)

New local lane newspec-c: status passed in newspec-c/results.json → passed (passed).

Detail:

Local 43c38a4f, model never called: billing on this build is a server job enqueued by the note save, so every local job ran on a note with no sentence (real job, family from the frozen template, no model call) or the chart was seeded with a suggestion the app's own code built from a scripted model answer (no job); proof: no billing ai_disclosure audit row with provider_ms, tripwire clean. Pixel 7 (Chromium 151) and iPhone 15 (WebKit 26.5) with a 55-word quote in both contexts, plus the discharge prompt and the error state: no horizontal page scroll, the card inside the screen, CODE and LEVEL lines on screen, every line including the long quotes wraps inside the card, the retry button inside the screen (16/16). Record only (our own check): the two discharge time buttons are 38 px tall (under 44 px); the retry button is 60 px.

Evidence: 4 attached.

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Lane V: visual-lane.ts reads a make-session.ts fixture (a fresh local account made with the admin key), and make-session.ts refuses dev, so it runs on the local stack only (Quinn 2026-10-14).. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).

This case has results elsewhere too (a case shows one result: a verdict beats blocked, a run beats a skip; within a tier the worse one, on a tie the earlier one (dev, dev lanes, local lane A/C, new local lanes), test out of date ranks above passed; when all are skips the dev one, unless dev only says "local only / can't run on dev" or gives the lane's own reason):

  • [local visual] passed (visual/results.json) — visual: passed → passed (passed) iphone15, pixel7: 28 judged check(s) passed, 0 failed. CODE and LEVEL lines are inside the screen, the 300-character RISK quote wraps, the retry button is ≥ 44 px tall, on Pixel 7 and iPhone 15.
